scenes.setting: Bansy Harbor at night, outside the Green Lemon Restaurant: Klein (as Gehrman Sparrow) knocks three times, gets silence, and kicks the door in; the pudgy owner Fox stands with a revolver while the lodgers watch from their doorways; the Timothy couple are brought down from upstairs and choose to join the Branch family outside

The walk to the telegraph office with a party of 15: Klein does a headcount, fires Sun Halo to steady everyone, tosses Azik's copper whistle as bait so three flying heads burn in Fire of Light, then nails a headless cloaked monster to the street with his cane and dissolves it with 'Sun!'; at the office door a woman's voice says the captain went to the cathedral and asks them to look out for her colleague Paavo Court
